includedSurfaces: Python rules engine and card content
deck builder, battle, replay, training entrypoints, LAN and online multiplayer
focused tests, rulebooks and deployment examples

windowsInstaller.sampleDecks: separate resources/data/decks directory; saved decks use the per-user game-data/decks directory
windowsInstaller.privateData: data/codeman_ai, ai_challenges, training traces, and local training actors are excluded
windowsInstaller.training: source package only; optional CUDA/PyTorch training dependencies are not bundled
windowsInstaller.asserts: external sibling directory next to ZZ-Project.exe

linuxBundle.firstLaunch: extract and run ./launch-electron.sh; Node.js, Electron and Python runtime are prepared in the user cache
linuxBundle.asserts: external asserts directory at the bundle root
linuxBundle.training: source package only; optional CUDA/PyTorch training dependencies are not bundled

intentionallyExcluded: data/codeman_ai memories, traces, candidates, reports and champion models
non-current local training runs and experiment outputs
local settings, caches, node_modules and git history
large media assets stored in the external asset pack
